content.text: {"decision":"accept_with_rework","confidence":0.95,"rationale":"The processor.py has two critical bugs that break the pipeline: (1) process_events writes output with encoding='latin-1' but sink.py reads with encoding='utf-8', which will corrupt non-ASCII characters; (2) transform_event wraps the processed dict in an envelope {'data': processed}, but sink.py expects flat dicts with top-level keys like 'event_id', 'timestamp', 'action', and 'user_name'. These mismatches will cause KeyError and UnicodeDecodeError in the sink.","repair_plan":"In processor.py: change the output file encoding from 'latin-1' to 'utf-8' in process_events, and remove the envelope wrapper so that the processed event dict is written directly as JSON lines instead of nesting it under a 'data' key.","observed_artifact_sha256":"085399c3991323c47e901c51135b4b6761a035df0e88f8b1620e45b11247162b"}
